skin.method: Continuous position-domain attachment solve with native shaft anchors and actual rigid saddle surface

equipment.flexibleTack: Front chest harness and its low return bend with the source body; complete saddle, bags and stirrups remain rigid.

validation.blenderCriticalPoses: Final package re-import: run0/.5/.875, jump.5 side/under, land.5 reviewed; earlier same-motion all-seven fixed-phase review plus all-key/midpoint structural checks.
validation.browserGameplay: Passed public-path SHA verification; six real NPC riders (three Viking T4 and three T5); walk/run, both-tier jump-land-idle, hit recovery, dismount/remount, death ejection and final-pose hold, LOD0/1/2, town saddle initialization/restoration. No application console errors.
validation.performance: Passed three sequential baseline/candidate pairs on headed Chrome / Apple M1 Pro; 3s warmup + 15s samples, 1280x720 DPR1; six real moving riders, natural LOD1/2. Exact served GLB responses hashed before warmup.

knownLimitations: Model-space run minimum Y is -0.008148m at sampled phase0.13; this is not a terrain/contact simulation.
Body/gear supports are shared at source seams; close underside fur compression remains around fixed original equipment.
Source JPEG maps are retained byte-for-byte at original resolutions; package size increased from 7,889,000 to 23,948,876 bytes.
Performance sampling covers natural LOD1/2 only; no large-battle or near-camera LOD0 stress claim.
